name: Sovcombank
note: Official partner of FC Lokomotiv since July 2025 (logo on the front of the playing shirt, below RZD). Also partner of HC Severstal. Shareholding as of 24 July 2024 (AK&M, reporting the bank's own message): MKAO SovCo Capital Partners and affiliated persons (owners of 5%+ and top management) 82.8%; sovereign funds of the Russian Federation, the Middle East and Asia 6.7% combined (the Russian fund share is not broken out); free float on the Moscow Exchange 10.1%. Unrated: the owners of the controlling holder SovCo Capital Partners are not identified, and a Russian state fund's share within the 6.7% is unknown.
